title: Network Hardening: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Think of fortifying a castle. You start by closing every door you don't need. On a network, that's hardening.

scenes.heading: Fortifying the castle
scenes.narration: Hardening means shrinking the attack surface. Turn off every port and service you don't use. Change every default password straight away. Use S S H and S N M P version three instead of the old, open ones. Keep the software up to date, and turn on logging.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Quick wins. Change defaults immediately. Shut unused ports. Use S S H even inside.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Close what you don't use. Change every default. Patch and log everything. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva hardening lab.
